 SSC JE 2026 exam city intimation slip released at ssc.gov.in: Direct link to check exam city, admit card date & October 27 deadline
 SECTIONS SSC JE 2026 exam city intimation slip released at ssc.gov.in: Direct link to check exam city, admit card date & October 27 deadline By Trending Desk , ET Online Last Updated: Oct 24, 2026, 12:47:00 PM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis SSC JE 2026 exam city intimation slip: The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the exam city intimation details for Junior Engineer (JE) 2026 Paper 1 at ssc.gov.in. The examination is scheduled for November 2 to 6, while the admit card is expected two to three days before each candidate's exam. Candidates using their own scribe or seeking eligible subject preference changes must complete the required process by October 27, 2026.
 ET Online SSC JE 2026 exam city intimation slip released for Paper 1
 Candidates preparing for the Staff Selection Commission's (SSC) Junior Engineer Examination 2026 can now check where they will appear for Paper 1. The commission has made the examination city details available on its official portal, ssc.gov.in , ahead of the November examination. With Paper 1 scheduled across November 2 to 6, candidates can log in to view their allotted city and plan their travel accordingly. Meanwhile, those using a scribe or seeking changes to certain subject preferences must complete the required formalities by October 27.
 SSC JE Paper 1 admit card 2026: How many days before the exam will it be available?
The examination city information and the admit card are two separate documents. While candidates can now access their city details, the admission certificate, the document required for appearing in the examination, is expected to be issued around two to three days before their respective test date. Candidates should not treat the city intimation details as a substitute for the admission certificate. They should keep an eye on the SSC portal for the release of the latter and check the instructions printed on it before heading to the examination centre.

 SSC JE 2026 timetable: Paper 1 and Telecommunication Engineering dates
The commission has announced the following examination schedule:
 Paper Examination dates 
 Junior Engineer Paper 1 November 2–6, 2026 
 JE (Telecommunication Engineering) November 30–December 1, 2026 
 Candidates appearing for the Telecommunication Engineering examination will have to wait for their city details. These are expected to be made available approximately eight to 10 days before the examination begins.
 Live Events
 SSC JE 2026: Two important deadlines fall on October 27
Apart from checking their examination city, certain candidates need to act before the October 27 deadline. The commission has outlined requirements relating to scribe registration and subject preferences.
 Own scribe facility: Fresh registration required
Candidates who intend to bring their own scribe may have to complete the registration process again. The SSC has integrated the process with Aadhaar authentication, making fresh registration necessary for candidates covered by the revised instructions.
 The scribe's One-Time Registration (OTR) must be mapped by October 27, 2026, at 11 pm. Candidates should ensure the registration and mapping are completed before the deadline to use the facility during the examination.
 Subject preference: Who can make changes?
Candidates who applied for JE (Telecommunication Engineering) and are also eligible for Scientific Assistant (SA) can make certain changes to their subject preferences under the commission's instructions.
Those who chose Scientific Assistant as their default subject can switch to Electrical and Telecommunication (EC/TC). Candidates seeking Computer Science and Information Technology (CS/IT) or Physics as their subject can make the selection through the city selection option.
The correction facility closes at 11 pm on October 27, 2026. No further changes will be accepted after that time. Candidates must appear for the subject mentioned in their admission certificate.
 SSC JE 2026 city intimation slip: Steps to download
To view their allotted examination city, candidates need to access their account on the SSC website.
 Open ssc.gov.in.
 Sign in using the required login credentials.
 Find the designated portal for the Junior Engineer Examination 2026.
 Open the examination city information available in the account.
 Check the details and save a copy for reference.
 SSC JE 2026 direct link : Open the official SSC website and log in to view the city details.
Candidates should verify their examination information carefully and return to the official portal for the admission certificate when it becomes available.
